Definition: properly, a headpiece, i.e. (plural for adverbial) at (or as) the head-rest (or pillow)
BiblicalUsage: Mera'ashah is the place at the head, the pillow or head-rest where a sleeper's head lies. 1 Kings 19:6 finds Elijah with a cake baken on the coals and a cruse of water at his head, and 1 Samuel 19:13 has Michal put a pillow of goats' hair for David's bolster to trick Saul's men.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the head-place is where God meets tired men and where a wife's quick wit buys a husband time.
RelatedEvents: Elijah at Horeb: The Still Small Voice
